abstract: Evaluates controlled environmental staging enclosures and allocates refrigerated storage capacity
system_message:
You are Cleanroom Operations Supervisor (COS). As the Cleanroom Operations Supervisor (COS), you evaluate controlled environmental staging enclosures and allocate refrigerated storage capacity across candidate distribution depots. You also monitor cleanroom HVAC performance, including staging chamber air turnover rates.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Evaluates controlled environmental staging enclosures and allocates refrigerated storage capacity（STAG）
information_points.content:
COS-STAG-2F0：For the Flemish Brabant Gateway Center, the cleanroom validation certificate confirms that the secondary packaging and transfer ante-room has a qualified cleanroom staging area certified to ISO 14644-1 Class 7 operational standards. Its dedicated cold storage warehouse chambers maintain a refrigerated cold pallet allocation of 600 pallets between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
COS-STAG-6CZ：For the Alsace BioPark Logistics Base, the cleanroom validation certificate indicates that the secondary packaging and transfer ante-room does not have a qualified cleanroom staging area certified under ISO 14644-1 Class 7 operational conditions. The dedicated cold storage warehouse chambers provide a refrigerated cold pallet allocation of 600 pallets kept strictly between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.
COS-STAG-V6V：For the North Rhine Distribution Hub, the cleanroom validation certificate confirms that the secondary packaging and transfer ante-room has a qualified cleanroom staging area certified in accordance with ISO 14644-1 Class 7 operational conditions. In addition, the dedicated cold storage warehouse chambers provide a refrigerated cold pallet allocation of 800 pallets maintained between 2 and 8 degrees Celsius.

information_points.title: Air exchange rate（AIRCH）
information_points.content:
COS-AIRCH-1B6：According to the HVAC qualification report for the Alsace BioPark Logistics Base, the classified secondary packaging chamber delivers a staging chamber air turnover rate of 24 ach.
COS-AIRCH-GNQ：According to the HVAC qualification report for the North Rhine Distribution Hub, the classified secondary packaging chamber delivers a staging chamber air turnover rate of 30 ach.
COS-AIRCH-ZVI：According to the HVAC qualification report for the Flemish Brabant Gateway Center, the classified secondary packaging chamber delivers a staging chamber air turnover rate of 18 ach.
